why: Lint cycle 10 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-10.md, lint-10.1 to lint-10.5 P2, lint-10.6 to lint-10.10 P3). The cycle 9 fixes hold: markdown-escape and calendar-link are silent, downshift, next-themes, a theme comparison choosing a class, a for-await over a decoded body, any staleTime in liveQuery and the mobile client hint are caught (9 earlier seeds turned to caught, none lost), and the playground, the 37 ejected primitives, the 26 weakened-config probes and the 16 hook probes are unchanged. The rest: the rival net's shape test reads remove-markdown's `removeMarkdown` and node-html-markdown's `NodeHtmlMarkdown`, converters that render nothing, and the `use<Name>` hook net reads react-supabase's `useSelect`, a database query, the fourth cycle the net reads a utility (lint-10.1); scheme-fork misses a scheme test as a cn() object value, a hoisted `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches` and usehooks-ts' `isDarkMode` (lint-10.2); no rule reads a scheme store of the app's own, shadcn's Vite theme provider writing `.dark` on the root or usehooks-ts' `useDarkMode`, though basalt's tokens key on `[data-theme]` (lint-10.3); a bar sized from data through a CSS custom property (`w-(--w)` with `style={{ '--w': … }}`) passes every rule while no-inline-styles' own message claims that route (lint-10.4); and reader-loop misses every read of a stream handed to a helper as a parameter, and a `let` binding (lint-10.5). Each seed and its line are in docs/v3/cycles/lint-10/fixtures/results.md; reproduce with `zsh docs/v3/cycles/lint-10/fixtures/run.sh $PWD /tmp/lint-cycle-10` after a package build.
what: The three rival-signature false alarms gone by a use test rather than a new except list or name shape, and the misses and message gaps of lint-10.2 to lint-10.10 caught, fixed or stated as known limits.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/preset.ts and packages/basalt-ui/src/lint/stylelint/** where lint-10.4's shadcn message or option lives
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/css/** (the theme's tokens and their scheme selector are the input, not the change)
packages/basalt-ui/src/core/** (BasaltProvider's scheme and setScheme are named by the messages, not changed)
packages/basalt-ui/src/data/** (liveQuery's dev assert is the reference, not the change)
change: False alarms first. lint-10.1: rival-signature judges a by-word import by how the file uses its binding: a JSX tag (`<Markdown>`) or a hook call renders a part and reports; a binding only called as a function or reached through a member (`removeMarkdown(s)`, `NodeHtmlMarkdown.translate(html)`) is a utility and passes; an import whose binding the file never uses keeps today's shape test. `useSelect` reads as a combobox only from downshift: key the `hooks` entry by package. Every rival seed of cycles 7 to 10 must stay caught (react-modal's `ReactModal`, react-calendar's `Calendar`, `marked`, `toast`, markdown-to-jsx's `Markdown`, react-modal-hook's `useModal`), and the JSDoc says which part of the lint-9.1 shape test the use test replaces. Then the misses. lint-10.2: scheme-fork reads a scheme test as the value of a class-shaped object key in cn()/clsx (`{ invert: resolvedTheme === 'dark' }`), a `const` bound to a scheme test (the `matchMedia` `.matches` read included) where the const chooses a class, and a boolean named for the dark scheme (`isDark`, `isDarkMode`, `darkMode`) as a scheme value. lint-10.3: a scheme store of the app's own reports: `classList.add`, `toggle` or `remove` of `'dark'`/`'light'`, or of a value typed as one, on `document.documentElement` or `document.body` (shadcn's Vite theme provider), and usehooks-ts' `useDarkMode` and `useTernaryDarkMode` on the scheme-library row by import name (usehooks-ts' other hooks stay legal). Both take the BasaltProvider `scheme` / `setScheme` fix. lint-10.4: html-data-marks reads an inline custom property whose value is computed from data when a class on the same element sizes by it (`w-(--w)`, `h-(--h)`, `[width:var(--w)]`), cast or not, with its BarList / ui/progress / ui/meter fix; and no-inline-styles' message stops claiming the custom-property route unless the preset makes that rule read it. lint-10.5: reader-loop reads a parameter typed `ReadableStream` (or untyped and named `body` or `stream`) read by `for await`, `.getReader()` or `.pipeThrough(…)`, and a `let` binding as it reads a `const`. The P3s: lint-10.6, media-query reads `userAgentData.mobile` through a TS cast or non-null on `navigator` and from a destructure, and only where the flag chooses a value (a conditional, `&&`, a JSX branch), not when it is passed as data (`track('open', { mobile })`); lint-10.7, reader-loop's `Next:` names the reasoned line waiver for a byte stream that is no event stream (a download's progress); lint-10.8, live-static-stale-time resolves the spread of a top-level `const` object inside the `liveQuery` argument; lint-10.9, react-popper and `@popperjs/core` join Floating UI's ban row and dayzed joins the date-picker part by name; lint-10.10, the scheme-library fix names the package it reports rather than next-themes for every row entry. A miss that cannot be read without a type-aware rule is stated as a known limit in its form's JSDoc.
commits: fix: one commit per rule family in packages/basalt-ui (import, class, structure, shadcn message). No app or example commit.
proof: run.sh from lint cycle 10 reports every seed of lint-10.2 to lint-10.6 and lint-10.8 to lint-10.9 caught or names its stated limit, and every `pass` mark silent but the core rule's stated closure shape (`core/no-use-before-define 3` and `6`). The probes all report: `const dark = matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches; <div className={dark ? 'opacity-90' : 'opacity-100'} />`, `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', on)`, `<div className="h-2 w-(--w) bg-muted" style={{ '--w': `${v}%` }} />` and `async function* f(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>) { for await (const c of body) yield c }`. sweep.sh reports 0 at `app` and `parts` for the playground, and eject.sh reports 0 findings on the 37 ejected primitives.
acceptance: The three rival-signature `pass` marks 9 to 11 of docs/v3/cycles/lint-10/fixtures (remove-markdown, node-html-markdown, react-supabase) are silent, and every rival seed of cycles 7 to 10 is still caught (seed report)
Each miss of lint-10.2, lint-10.3, lint-10.4, lint-10.5, lint-10.6, lint-10.8 and lint-10.9 is caught (seed report) or stated as a known limit in its form's JSDoc
The `pass` marks `data-primitive/reader-loop 2` and `viewport-keyed/media-query 5` are silent, or their message's `Next:` names the reasoned line waiver for that shape (lint-10.6, lint-10.7)
No other `pass` mark of docs/v3/cycles/lint-10/fixtures fires, and the playground copy at `app` and `parts` reports 0 (seed report, sweep)
